1. (Currently Amended) A process for obtaining a valued material from an aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution containing the valued material comprising adding to the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution a Maillard reaction product, the Maillard reaction product comprising an adduct of (1) an amine reactant and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof, __wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by heating the amine reactant and the reducing sugar to a temperature sufficient to form covalent bonds between the amine reactant and the reducing sugar__.

3. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the amine reactant contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about 1:1 to about 3:1, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product exhibits browning and has a molecular weight greater than the sum of the molecular weights of the amine reactant and the reducing sugar__.

4. (Previously presented)

5. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product has a cationic functionality, a sulfur functionality, a phosphorus functionality, a sulfate functionality, a sulfonate functionality, a hydroxamic acid functionality, a silane functionality, a phenolic functionality, or an aza crown chelating functionality, __wherein the functionality is covalently bonded to the adduct of the amine reactant and the reducing sugar__.

6. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine reactant and the reducing sugar __at a temperature of at least 100°C__.

9. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the valued material is obtained by sedimentation, filtration, or flotation, __wherein the Maillard reaction product modifies the surface properties of the valued material or impurities to enable separation__.

10. (Previously presented)

11. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product depresses the value material or an impurity in the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution, __by modifying the hydrophobicity or charge of the surface thereof__.

13. (Currently Amended) A process for separating a valued material from a suspension, dispersion, or solution, comprising: treating the liquid suspension, dispersion, or solution with a Maillard reaction product of (1) an amine and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof to provide a treated mixture, __wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by heating the amine and the reducing sugar to form covalent bonds__; and removing a purified valued material from the treated mixture.

15. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine and the reducing sugar, __at a temperature of at least 100°C__.

16. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the amine contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about 1:1 to about 3:1, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product exhibits browning and has a molecular weight greater than the sum of the molecular weights of the amine and the reducing sugar__.

17. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof contains an aldehyde moiety reactive with Cu+2 to produce a carboxylic acid moiety, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed prior to treatment of the suspension, dispersion, or solution__.

18. (Previously presented)

19. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product depresses the value material or an impurity present in the treated mixture, or wherein the Maillard reaction product promotes flotation of the value material or the impurity in the treated mixture, __by modifying the hydrophobicity or charge of the surface thereof__.

20. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the purified valued material is removed from the treated mixture by sedimentation, filtration, or flotation, __wherein the Maillard reaction product modifies the surface properties of the valued material or impurities to enable separation__.
